create_ModelEMA: create a ModelEMA instance to perform exponential moving average on a PyTorch model
update_ModelEMA: update the EMA state by calling update on the ModelEMA instance after each training step
swap_ModelEMA: swap a model to its EMA weights temporarily using the swap context manager for validation
save_ModelEMA_state_dict: save the ModelEMA state and count by calling state_dict on the ModelEMA instance
load_ModelEMA_state_dict: load a previously saved ModelEMA state by calling load_state_dict with the saved state dictionary
